sar.narrative: On December 7, 2016, customer C02923 initiated a suspicious online transaction of $100.07 (Transaction ID 3523199) on card C02923-K1. This transaction is highly anomalous as it falls below the customer's average transaction amount of $176.02 and recent transaction history, which typically ranges between $116.96 and $141.08. The transaction originated from a newly registered device profile running iOS 9.3.5 on mobile Safari with a 1024x768 resolution, which is notably shared among 3,103 other customers, indicating potential fraud infrastructure. The transaction carried a risk score of 0.54 and was processed through the online channel in primary region 330.0. This activity aligns with a confirmed account takeover pattern, as customer C02923 has a history of prior fraudulent activity on this same card, including closed cases CC-2400 ($350.99 exposure), CC-2717 ($896.08 exposure), and CC-2857 ($539.97 exposure). Consequently, an automated case (HHG-005) was created, a Level 2 report was filed, and the card was blocked at the Level 1 threshold to prevent further unauthorized access.
